high_level_description: This image is a collage of nine photographs showcasing different views of NSK Road during various times of the day, primarily focusing on the road's appearance under different lighting conditions. Top Row: The first photo on the left shows NSK Road during what appears to be early morning or late afternoon, with soft sunlight illuminating the road and surrounding trees. The second photo in the middle captures the road at dusk or early evening, with streetlights turned on and the sky transitioning into shades of orange and pink.
